Name: Slime Hutch Water Troughs for Content Patcher (CP)
Author: lydocia
Description:
[left][size=3]﻿[/size][/left][size=3][img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hdr_description.png[/img]

Different versions of the water troughs in Slime Hutches.

[/size][left][size=3][img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hr.png[/img][/size][/left][size=3][img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hdr_install.png[/img]
[/size][list=1]
[size=3]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
3. Download the .zip file and extract into your /Mods folder[left]﻿[/left][/size][/list][size=3][img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hr.png[/img]
[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hdr_use.png[/img]

By default, the mod will change your troughs to the purple version.

Open content.json and change "purple" to grey, red or green to get the other versions.

[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hr.png[/img]
[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hdr_bugreports.png[/img]

[size=3]If you have any [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][size=3]-spe[size=3]cific issues, please direct them to the devs on their respective mod page.[/size]﻿[size=3]
[/size][size=3]
Please report any other issues you may find in the 'Bugs' tab (as I might miss them in the general posts tab).[/size][/size]
